gamerule.ocwo.task_limit.description: Number of fluid flow tasks done every tick (the tick waits for them). Lower it if the game lags
gamerule.ocwo.fluid_displacement_limit.d: Maximum distance for fluids to find the way out when block placed in (0 = no displacement)
gamerule.ocwo.water_hot_fluid_evaporatio: Water evaporation upon contact with lava
Number of layers that will evaporate (0 = no evaporation)
gamerule.ocwo.farmland_water_intake.desc: Farmland consumes water, farmland also need to be connected with dirt-like block with water (0 = no consumption, -1 = vanilla behavior)
gamerule.ocwo.bucket_area_pickup.descrip: true (AREA): a bucket used on a block that is not full also takes water from the connected blocks around it on the same layer (up to 16 blocks, 4 blocks away), until full. false (COLUMN): only the targeted block and the block below it (PhysEx behaviour)
gamerule.ocwo.pressure_operations_per_ti: Work done by water pressure every tick: each block of water explored by a search counts 1, each level of water moved counts 1. The tick waits until it is done, so water behaves the same on every computer; lower it if the game lags (water under pressure then moves more slowly)
gamerule.ocwo.moisture_blocks_per_step.d: Number of blocks whose moisture is updated every 10 ticks (absorption, transmission, seepage, state changes). The tick waits until they are done; lower it if the game lags (blocks then get wet and dry more slowly)
gamerule.ocwo.pressure_flow_max.descript: Water under pressure flows faster when the difference of height is larger (square root: 1 block x1, 4 blocks x2, 9 blocks x3, 16 blocks x4). This is the maximum speed-up, in levels per tick and per block of opening. 1 = no speed-up
gamerule.ocwo.water_simulation_scale.des: Percentage applied to all the work quotas of the water simulation (flow, pressure, moisture). 100 = normal. Lower it if the game lags: water moves more slowly but the game keeps up
gamerule.ocwo.water_time_budget_ms.descr: Optional: maximum time per tick for water pressure, equalization and moisture, in milliseconds. 0 = off (recommended): every tick finishes its work and the game slows down instead of the water. Above 0, water depends on the speed of the computer
gamerule.ocwo.pressure_search_limit.desc: Max number of columns of water explored to find the highest surface and the lowest free point of a body of water (hydraulic pressure: tunnels fill completely, connected vessels reach the same level, fountains). 0 = pressure disabled
ocwo.debug.command: OCWO debug information is now in the F3 screen (F3+F6 to choose the OCWO lines: ocwo_water_at_head, ocwo_looking_at, ocwo_simulation).
ocwo.debug.head.pressure: Pressure: %s blocks (%s levels) below the surface at y=%s
ocwo.debug.body.incomplete: Water body: over %s columns, analysis incomplete (retried later)
ocwo.debug.body.pending: Water body: transfers pending, low point y=%s (%s columns)
ocwo.debug.block.pending_release: %s moisture units waiting to be released as water
ocwo.debug.block.permeability: Permeability: down %s, up %s, N %s, S %s, E %s, W %s
ocwo.debug.sim.quotas: Quotas (scale %s%%): flow %s, pressure %s per tick, moisture %s per 10 ticks
ocwo.debug.sim.limits: Pressure speed-up max x%s, time budget: %s
